action_timeline.rationale: Uses the preceding supported Vanilla grant.

action_timeline.precondition: Artillery dead and its outstanding projectiles resolved; otherwise reject this handoff.
Artillery clearance gate satisfied and Steward's slot vacated.
Hostile spawn exhaustion, all hostile enemies dead and all hostile projectiles resolved.
Hostile-clearance gate and medical tile vacated.
Hostile-clearance gate and medical tile vacated.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Both medics are established at 56 seconds, all four interception duties remain occupied and neither civilian has died.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A missing interceptor exposes an exit or civilian; a lost income producer can prevent the earlier second-caster deployment.
battle_phases.goal: Establish four interception duties and both assigned medics without losing the economic chain.
handoff_requirements: No ordinary operator is assigned civilian blocking.
responsibilities: Midnight and Plume attack eastern roadblocks while intercepting outer traffic.
Lancet bridges the lower opening before Hibiscus inherits treatment.
battle_phases.start_condition: Stage begins with ten DP and no deployed operators.
survival_dependencies: Fang and Vanilla survive early queues and retain their supported income opportunities.
The first civilian survives any officer exposure during eastern detention.
Ansel begins treating the upper formation before accumulated damage becomes fatal.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Artillery is dead, outstanding artillery projectiles have resolved and both defender handoffs have completed.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Surviving artillery can erase later defenders or civilians; insufficient firing opportunity invalidates the 165-second transition.
battle_phases.goal: Turn actual medical coverage into sustained artillery damage while replacing the central opening pair.
handoff_requirements: Each defender deploys immediately after the predecessor's retreat.
Steward leaves only after verified artillery and projectile clearance.
Durin inherits the vacated slot under Ansel's baseline coverage.
responsibilities: Steward attacks eligible artillery with supported high-defense preference.
Lava adds lower eastern damage from 86 seconds.
Each medic treats its caster and assigned blockers.
Cardigan and Beagle inherit central interception at 104 and 116 seconds.
battle_phases.start_condition: Steward deploys at 68 seconds with Ansel already covering his tile.
survival_dependencies: Both casters receive actual treatment after injury.
Medical selection and throughput prevent a second lethal shell.
The medics survive without assumed reciprocal coverage.
Vanilla survives through the lower interception handoff; Fang survives through the upper handoff.

battle_phases.completion_condition: All hostile spawns are exhausted, every hostile is dead, no hostile projectile remains and no leak has occurred.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A leak permanently fails acceptance; premature withdrawal exposes both civilian release and remaining queues.
battle_phases.goal: Hold every hostile corridor and clear armored and late raider queues.
handoff_requirements: Melantha occupies Plume's tile immediately after retreat.
Medical withdrawal requires actual combat clearance, including after the final 211-second spawn.
responsibilities: Cardigan and Beagle hold central queues under assigned treatment.
Durin and Lava provide central arts.
Fresh Melantha inherits upper outer traffic; Midnight retains lower outer traffic.
battle_phases.start_condition: The artillery clearance gate authorizes Durin's entry.
survival_dependencies: Both medics remain alive and treatment reaches pressured blockers.
Arts clearance prevents three-block queues from overflowing.
Outer officers remain separated from western detained civilians.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Both protected arrivals are recorded, protected deaths and leaks are zero, remaining life is positive and no active enemies remain.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A missing arrival leaves project acceptance incomplete; any protected death permanently fails it.
battle_phases.goal: Destroy western detention and observe both civilians safely reach their objectives.
handoff_requirements: The medics vacate their tiles before clearers deploy.
Do not equate roadblock destruction or elapsed time with safe arrival.
responsibilities: Gallus attacks the upper western roadblock.
Observe civilian movement and both objective arrivals without assigning ordinary blocking or attacks against them.
battle_phases.start_condition: The hostile-clearance gate is satisfied at the scheduled release transition.
survival_dependencies: No hostile or unresolved hostile projectile remains.
Fresh clearers use ordinary damage without unsupported talent or splash credit.

corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Steward and Lava must finish the artillery during their eastern firing opportunities. No withdrawal based only on elapsed time.
Plume clears eastern detention and kills nearby officers; western detention is released by Gallus after combat.
Midnight clears eastern detention before the second civilian arrives and retains lower outer officers; 12F handles final western release.
Fang opens with Vanilla's reciprocal damage. Cardigan inherits at 104 seconds; Lava and then Durin clear accumulated central enemies.
Vanilla remains under Hibiscus through the lower handoff. Beagle inherits at 116 seconds; Lava and Durin provide clearance.
Plume retains upper outer traffic until Melantha inherits at 166 seconds. Ansel owns their treatment.
Midnight retains lower outer traffic throughout combat, with Hibiscus treatment and two arts windows.

deployment_positions_and_directions.role: Opening upper central block and reciprocal central damage.
Opening lower central block, reciprocal damage and three budgeted DP activations.
Eastern lower roadblock clearance and continuous lower outer interception.
Economical upper outer interception and eastern upper roadblock clearance.
Opening global recovery and lower treatment bridge.
Baseline coverage of upper interceptor, upper central blocker and Steward.
Baseline coverage of lower interceptor, lower central blocker and Lava.
Medically covered artillery damage over the upper eastern flight segment.
Medically covered artillery damage over the lower eastern flight segment and central arts damage.
Upper central replacement; ordinary attacks and three-block capacity only.
Lower central replacement and supported defense windows.
Post-artillery arts coverage of both central blocking tiles.
Fresh upper outer replacement before late officer traffic.
Fresh upper western roadblock clearance after combat.
Fresh lower western roadblock clearance after combat.

formation_structure.artillery_geometry: Steward's UP range reaches the upper eastern column-7 segment; Lava's DOWN range reaches the lower eastern segment. Their coverage overlaps during transit, while their stationary coverage differs.
formation_structure.civilian_protection: Eastern roadblocks are attacked by the outer interceptors. Western roadblocks remain until combat ends. Once a civilian reaches western detention, column-5 interception separates it from approaching officers.
formation_structure.combat_slots: Four ground interceptors, two assigned medics and two eastern casters occupy eight slots. Lancet leaves before Hibiscus enters. Every replacement vacates its predecessor's slot first.
formation_structure.lower_support: Hibiscus [5,3] RIGHT covers [6,5], [4,5], [5,6] and her own tile.
formation_structure.support_limit: The medics do not cover each other. Coverage permits treatment but does not establish selection or sufficient throughput. Their distance from the central blockers increases from the previous arrangement; artillery splash geometry and resulting casualties still require observation.
formation_structure.upper_support: Ansel [2,3] RIGHT covers [1,5], [3,5], [2,6], his own tile and later Durin [2,5] without skill range extension.

formation_transitions.transition: Withdraw Lancet; Hibiscus inherits the same medical tile at frame 1680.
Establish the second supported artillery attacker at 86 seconds, funding this before central defender replacements.
Cardigan immediately inherits Fang's tile and upper queue.
Beagle immediately inherits Vanilla's tile and lower queue.
Only after artillery death and resolution of its outstanding projectiles, exchange Steward for Durin.
Exchange Plume for fresh Melantha before late upper outer traffic.
Only after all hostile clearance and projectile resolution, exchange the medics for fresh western roadblock clearers.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Use only the selected catalog operators with rarity 1-3 and normal_mode=true. Every deployment uses the listed legal terrain and direction. Forbidden deployment set is exactly [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
At most eight simultaneous deployments; process each listed retreat before its replacement deployment.

Using Fang's evidenced self-cost reduction, initial DP plus natural recovery, four Fang grants and three Vanilla grants funds 168 deployment DP by 116 seconds, without refunds. Missed grants reflect failed survival or deployment continuity and invalidate dependent actions; do not repair them silently.
Record actual Ansel-to-Steward and Hibiscus-to-Lava healing after injury. Range membership alone does not close either survival duty.
Both medics must survive their assigned combat windows. Repeated direct shells, collateral allocation or selection starvation can invalidate the formation despite correct ranges.

Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians. Limit eastern detention exposure by roadblock clearance and officer interception; western detention is retained until combat ends. Protected deaths must remain zero.
Steward's scheduled withdrawal requires artillery death and resolution of outstanding projectiles. Failure of that gate rejects the scheduled handoff rather than assuming a kill.
The release transition requires exhausted hostile spawns, no active hostile enemies and no unresolved hostile projectiles. Civilian presence alone does not prevent release.
Require remaining_life>0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected deaths and exactly two safe protected arrivals. Record operator deaths separately.

pressure_window_responsibilities.attacker_target_and_expected_attacks: The central vanguards attack across adjacent lanes. Plume needs approximately 11 ordinary hits against an isolated initial raider; Midnight needs approximately nine ordinary physical hits, excluding unsupported talents. Roadblock competition can increase elapsed clearance time.
pressure_window_responsibilities.handoff: Neither central vanguard may leave before its later defender handoff. Opening deaths invalidate the survival and income chain.
pressure_window_responsibilities.incoming_pressure: Four opening approaches, artillery activity and possible officer contact with the first detained civilian.
pressure_window_responsibilities.support: Lancet supplies its evidenced deployment heal and lower bridge; Ansel arrives at 44 seconds and Hibiscus at 56.

pressure_window_responsibilities.attacker_target_and_expected_attacks: Steward and Lava target artillery whenever geometry and selection permit. Working output hypothesis: approximately 31 Steward hits and 17 Lava hits on the artillery. Six enhanced Steward hits among 31 plus 17 ordinary Lava hits would exceed 13000 damage under the supplied formula; these counts are predictions to verify, not established firing opportunities.
pressure_window_responsibilities.handoff: Require actual treatment, caster survival and artillery death. If treatment or available firing time fails, retain surviving duties and classify the candidate as failed; no invented replacement or fixed inherited HP repair.
pressure_window_responsibilities.incoming_pressure: A caster can survive one unhealed direct artillery hit, but not two. Adjacent ground units may receive collateral damage.
pressure_window_responsibilities.selection_and_throughput: Steward's supported high-defense preference favors the 800-DEF artillery over listed ordinary enemies when both are eligible. Lava has competing ground targets. Ansel supplies about 127 baseline or 178 enhanced HP/s; Hibiscus about 121 or 182. These rates cannot guarantee recovery from repeated shells plus collateral injuries.
pressure_window_responsibilities.support: Ansel covers Steward continuously from deployment; Hibiscus covers Lava continuously from deployment. Their first enhancement windows are 99-124 and 96-116 seconds respectively. Neither medic receives assumed reciprocal healing.

pressure_window_responsibilities.attacker_target_and_expected_attacks: Cardigan and Beagle retain central enemies; Lava and Durin supply arts against armored queues. Melantha replaces Plume for late upper officers. An isolated officer requires approximately six ordinary Melantha hits, excluding unsupported talents.
pressure_window_responsibilities.handoff: Both defender replacements occur immediately after listed retreats. Durin enters only after the artillery clearance gate.
pressure_window_responsibilities.incoming_pressure: Repeated officers, armored enemies and paired late raiders can exhaust blocking capacity.
pressure_window_responsibilities.support: The original medics retain baseline coverage of their assigned ground tiles. Durin is inside Ansel's baseline range. Medical selection among injured recipients remains an observed dependency.

pressure_window_responsibilities.attacker_target_and_expected_attacks: Maintain all four interceptors and central arts until every remaining hostile dies; no fixed attack count is assumed for queued enemies.
pressure_window_responsibilities.handoff: The 260-second release transition requires actual clearance. Failure to satisfy it invalidates the scheduled release.
pressure_window_responsibilities.incoming_pressure: Last spawns and surviving central queues; spawn exhaustion alone does not close combat.
pressure_window_responsibilities.support: Both medics remain deployed through verified hostile and projectile clearance.

pressure_window_responsibilities.attacker_target_and_expected_attacks: Gallus and 12F attack their assigned western roadblocks. Required attack counts are UNKNOWN because roadblock HP and defense were not supplied.
pressure_window_responsibilities.handoff: Observe two safe protected arrivals; continue observation if necessary. A time horizon is not an arrival event.
pressure_window_responsibilities.incoming_pressure: Must be zero hostile pressure and zero unresolved hostile projectiles.
pressure_window_responsibilities.support: Fresh clearers require no medical survival chain after combat. Credit only ordinary modeled arts damage.

skill_intents.intent: Budget four grants only while continuously deployed and alive through the fourth grant.
Three +6 activations; account for ten active seconds pausing SP recovery. No fourth grant is required.
Arts at 61 and 171 seconds; forty active seconds followed by seventy charging seconds.
Attack and attack-speed enhancement at 85 and 155 seconds; no passive ATK credit.
Reserve the first enhancement for artillery exposure. Baseline geometry already covers Steward.
Enhance treatment at 96,146,196,246 seconds; no unsupported passive ATK credit.
Deployment SP permits the first activation at 96 seconds. Credit attack speed and ordinary single-target arts only.
Defense enhancement at 156 and 226 seconds; no passive DEF credit.
First supported attack enhancement at 206 seconds, forty seconds after deployment.
Use supported attack-SP enhanced hits and verified runtime high-defense priority; exact client tie-breaking remains UNKNOWN.
Ordinary modeled attacks only; do not credit unsupported self-healing, dodge, RES reduction or splash geometry.

tactical_thesis: Move both medics to column 3 facing RIGHT, place the eastern artillery attackers at column 6 inside baseline healing range, and fund earlier Lava by retaining the opening central pair longer. Use Plume for the economical upper opening, replace both central vanguards before late pressure, and preserve four interception duties until hostile clearance. Civilian release follows verified hostile and projectile clearance.
